location_exception_reason: GRP cabins are manufactured products with standardised specifications (material, panel thickness, insulation, dimensions). Origin location does not alter the product's functional attributes or buyer decision calculus — a 4×4 ft GRP security cabin from Mumbai performs identically to one from Hyderabad. Location is a logistics/delivery factor, not a product attribute.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in GRP cabin titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'GRP Cabin Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged; the cabin itself is the product, not the business relationship.
